name: Miyoshi Mei
source:
A rookie editor for the occult magazine "Paranormal Idola" and Nogawa's assistant.
An unlucky 23-year-old who's easily frightened and gets anxious about ghosts, yet somehow got assigned to an occult magazine.
She tends to get carried away and lacks cautiousness, but her strong communication abilities make her a great asset to Nogawa.

[Translated from the [url=https://game.mages.co.jp/shikai/#character]official website[/url]]
